title_ar: الجواب الصحيح لمن بدل دين المسيح
title_es_or_en: Al-Jawab al-sahih li-man baddala din al-Masih (The Correct Answer to Those Who Changed the Religion of the Messiah)
edition_note: Shamela 170 / OpenITI 0728IbnTaymiyya.JawabSahih.Shamela0000170-ara1. Printed ed.: Dar al-Asima (Riyadh), 2nd ed. 1419/1999, eds. Ali ibn Hasan, Abd al-Aziz ibn Ibrahim, Hamdan ibn Muhammad. Header BookVOLS=6. Page numbers (vol, page) from OpenITI PageV markers (volume markers of this edition). Also in the TSV: JK000330 version (1,398,883 chars) — not used.
genre: polemical treatise (radd) against Christian doctrine (Trinity, incarnation, crucifixion, scripture)
notes: Main source. Ibn Taymiyya speaks in his own voice in most chapters, but quotes at length Christian authors: Ibn al-Batriq (Eutychius) and al-Hasan ibn Ayyub (vol. 4, approx. pp. 157-400), and Paul-of-Antioch-type creed material and gospel-based arguments. Chapter headings are in brackets [فصل: ...]. Shamela/OpenITI text is a digital transcription; no independent check of page images done by this researcher.
